item.title: FDA Reconsideration of Atara/Pierre Fabre Cell Therapy (Ebvallo)
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA has reversed its decision on Ebvallo (tabelecleucel), an allogeneic T-cell therapy developed by Atara Biotherapeutics and Pierre Fabre, after previously rejecting it twice. The agency will reconsider the treatment for EBV-positive post-transplant lymphoproliferative disease (EBV+PTLD), raising hope for approval in a rare oncology indication.
  • MoAs: Ebvallo is an allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy that targets cells infected with Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) by engaging the T-cell receptor and eliminating EBV-positive tumor cells.
  • Sources: BioSpace, Fierce Pharma, Endpoints News, STAT News

item.title: Another Unituxin Challenger
item.description:
• Summary: A new challenger to Unituxin (dinutuximab) emerges in the neuroblastoma space, following Y-mAbs' move. Oncology Pipeline reports on the next anti-GD2 therapy candidate targeting high-risk neuroblastoma.
  • MoAs: Anti-GD2 monoclonal antibody (potential alternative or bispecific design)
  • Sources: Oncology Pipeline
